prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about light bent into arcs by mass. Around 70 BPM, E major. A short piano phrase arrives twice: once dry, once delayed, stretched and inverted in stereo as if passing a lens. Glass bowls and high strings draw faint arcs. Lucid and observational. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No horror drones, no sci-fi zaps, no trailer drums.

[00:00–00:20] Dry piano phrase, five notes, center image.
[00:20–01:00] The same phrase returns delayed, slightly time-stretched, panned as an arc.
[01:00–01:45] Glass bowls and high strings trace Einstein-ring-like circles around the motif.
[01:45–02:30] Dual images collapse back toward one piano line and fade.
